description: This file contains the PHP class definition for Opencart's Admin Controller for CMS topics, including methods for listing, editing, and managing CMS topics within the admin panel.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS topics in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the category listing page with breadcrumbs and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the list of topics, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares the list of topics, applying sorting and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method for listing topics; sets up view data and loads the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a topic, with all necessary data and scripts.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing topic; processes form submission.
